basic_information.short_title: Aleem Abdulazis S. Mimbantas Memorial Hospital Act of 2023
basic_information.official_title: AN ACT CREATING AND ESTABLISHING A LEVEL 1 GENERAL HOSPITAL TO BE KNOWN AS ALEEM ABDULAZIS S. MIMBANTAS MEMORIAL HOSPITAL IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF MASIU, PROVINCE OF LANAO DEL SUR AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
signed_by: Prof. Raby B. Angkal, Secretary General
basic_information.effectivity: 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation
basic_information.title_note: The act's own short title calls it the “Aleem Abdulazis S. Mimbantas Memorial Hospital Act of 2023”, although it was passed in December 2024 and approved in January 2025. The registry records the short title as enacted.

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Creates a 50-bed general hospital in Masiu, Lanao del Sur, named for Alim Abdul Aziz Mimbantas — the MILF vice chairperson whose burial site BAA 60 declared a memorial.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: The Organic Law duty to build a general hospital system, with the policy section adding a specific aim: to respond adequately to emergencies, disasters and emerging diseases.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: A 50-bed general hospital is established under the direct control and supervision of the Ministry of Health, with any future expansion tied to a hospital development plan the Ministry prepares.
who_will_be_affected: Residents of Masiu and surrounding Lanao del Sur
Patients needing hospital care in the area
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: In force since 2025 — 15 days after publication.

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: NOW LAW. A 50-bed general hospital for Masiu, Lanao del Sur, with ₱50 million named in the act.

key_terms_explained.General hospital: A facility providing a broad range of medical services rather than a specialism.
key_terms_explained.Hospital development plan: The Ministry of Health document on which any future increase in capacity depends.
key_terms_explained.MPBF: Miscellaneous and Personnel Benefit Fund — the budget line the initial ₱50 million comes from.
key_terms_explained.Aleem / Alim: A scholar of Islamic learning; part of the name of the man the hospital commemorates.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Short title: the “Aleem Abdulazis S. Mimbantas Memorial Hospital Act of 2023”.

Section 2 — Policy: comprehensive and integrated health service delivery and a general hospital system established by law, so the basic right to life is attainable through prompt intervention of excellent and affordable medical services — and, to adequately respond to emergencies, disasters and emerging diseases, the Bangsamoro Government shall protect the interest and promote the well-being and the medical needs of the Bangsamoro People.

Section 3 — Establishes a fifty-bed capacity general hospital in the Municipality of Masiu, Province of Lanao del Sur, to be known as the Aleem Abdulazis S. Mimbantas Memorial Hospital, under the direct control and supervision of the Ministry of Health. Any further increase in bed capacity and upgrading of health care services and facilities shall be based on a hospital development plan prepared by the Ministry of Health to reflect the development goals of the hospital.

Section 4 — An initial ₱50,000,000 is charged against the Miscellaneous and Personnel Benefit Fund of the 2025 General Appropriation Act of the Bangsamoro, with later operations in the annual appropriations.
Section 5 — The Ministry of Health shall promulgate implementing rules and regulations within 60 days from enactment.
Section 7 — Takes effect 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation.
